chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The supplication after the obligatory prayer is superior to the voluntary prayer.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward of supplication after obligatory prayer compared to voluntary prayer?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) establishes that the supplication (du'a) immediately following the obligatory prayer holds greater merit than voluntary (nafl) prayer, a view supported by scholars who distinguish between the ritual act of worship and the intimate communion of du'a. This hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on the post-prayer supplications as a critical moment for spiritual elevation and divine connection, often considered the 'pillar of the religion' in other narrations.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The supplication after the Obligatory (Salāt) is superior than the Salāt prayed voluntarily’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Prayer after an obligatory Salah (prayer) is better than after non-obligatory Salah (prayer).”’
